title: Libre2 sensor changes not uploaded to Nightscout
symptom: When changing a Libre2 sensor, xDrip (20191122) force closes when the new sensor is detected by LibreLink (patched), and xDrip never sends a 'Sensor Change' treatment record to Nightscout, although the new sensor is listed in System Status.
fix: Disable the setting 'check libre serial' in settings-->less common settings to fix the force close issue. For the missing sensor change upload, a later xDrip release (July 31, 2021) added flags for stopping or starting sensors, which may address the issue.
evidence_quote: For the sensor ID change, I think you could simply disable the setting "check libre serial" in settings-->less common settings. This should fix the issue of ID changes included in your first bulletpoint
